title: W3Pass
tagline: One stop solution for your decentralized Password Management needs powered by self-custodial web3 encryption.
description: W3Pass protocol allows users to store their credentials on-chain in an self-encrypted format.
how_its_made: We developed our client-side backend in python while the frontend in react and JS which turned out to be tricky to integrate. But we were able to connect those two parts using Node.js.
